# Hole layouts with a true scale, in the frame of the hands (generated by measure_cad_references.py)

All lengths in mm. Plan view of the finger face as the player sees it. The **hand axis** is the mean direction of the two hand lines (L pinky → L index, R index → R pinky); *across* means perpendicular to it, + toward the player. Nothing here depends on how the body is turned. The metrics are computed by `ocarina_addon/ergonomics.py`, the module behind the add-on's `ergo_*` checks. The add-on rows use the hole centres on the cavity surface.

**Every distance in sections 1 and 2 is a plan-view distance.** The add-on's check reports give the finger pitch and the subhole distance as straight 3D distances, which are larger where the deck curves away (P1-80: L pinky to L ring is 15.6 mm here and 17.2 mm in 3D; a 9.50 mm subhole slide is 9.4 mm here).

## 2. Subholes

The parent is the nearest finger hole of **either** hand. *Forward* is perpendicular to the parent hand's pinky → index line, on the side its fingertips point to (left hand: toward the player; right hand: away). The last column is what `measure_reference.py` reports instead: the nearest hole of the hand the subhole was assumed to belong to.

| Layout | First subhole (opens B4) | Second subhole (opens C5) | Assumed-hand parent of the first / distance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Miracle AO10-AC (photo, catalogue scale) | R_index, 8.7 mm (8.7 forward, 0.2 toward the index; 1° off the line's normal) | R_middle, 7.3 mm (7.1 forward, 1.6 toward the index; 13° off the line's normal) | L_index / 15.4 |
| ECAN3 Ocarina of Time v3 (CAD) | L_ring, 9.1 mm (9.1 forward, -0.7 toward the index; -4° off the line's normal) | R_middle, 7.5 mm (7.5 forward, 0.4 toward the index; 3° off the line's normal) | L_ring / 9.1 |

| Add-on P1-80 (built, layout centre 16 mm) | L_ring, 9.4 mm (9.4 forward, 0.0 toward the index; 0° off the line's normal) | R_middle, 7.5 mm (7.5 forward, 0.0 toward the index; 0° off the line's normal) | L_ring / 9.4 |
